classes.name: FEmTool_ElementsOfRefMatrix
classes.summary: this class describes the functions needed for calculating matrix elements of RefMatrix for linear criteriums (Tension, Flexion and Jerk) by Gauss integration. Each function from set gives value Pi(u)'*Pj(u)' or Pi(u)''*Pj(u)'' or Pi(u)'''*Pj(u)''' for each i and j, where Pi(u) is i-th basis function of expansion and (') means derivative.

instanceMethods.name: NbVariables
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of variables of the function. It is supposed that NbVariables = 1.

instanceMethods.name: NbEquations
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of equations of the function.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: computes the values <F> of the functions for the variable <X>. returns True if the computation was done successfully, False otherwise. F contains results only for i<=j in following order: P0*P0, P0*P1, P0*P2... P1*P1, P1*P2,... (upper triangle of matrix {PiPj})
